result.reason: The Credit Data position is appropriately narrowed and Client ownership is confirmed while preserving TrueLink’s service-use rights. However, the deliverables position is incomplete: stating that Client “retains” rights in Support Services results does not assign newly created IP, does not cover all deliverables or work product, and omits both the required licence to embedded Vendor IP and an express exclusion of joint ownership. It also does not reach the fallback because there is no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables.
